## About the podcast

Source: https://podcast.suedeai.ai/about

About

About the AI Suede podcast

AI Suede is the podcast feed for Jason Colapietro, also known as Johnny Suede, founder of Suede AI. It carries conversations, AMAs, and clips on creator ownership, music IP as a real-world asset, programmable media, on-chain royalties, and what it actually takes to ship as a solo founder.

Episodes are pulled from the @aisuede YouTube channel and synced to a standard podcast RSS feed so the same conversations are listenable in any podcast app.

For more on the host, see Jason Colapietro's founder bio. For more on the parent company, see About Suede AI.

Page last updated 2026-07-15.

## Contact

Source: https://podcast.suedeai.ai/contact

Contact

Get in touch.

For booking, guest pitches, feedback, or press, reach the host at jason@suedeai.ai.

For questions about Suede AI itself, see About Suede AI or the founder bio for Jason Colapietro.

Booking a guest spot or an interview

AI Suede carries Jason's own episodes and his guest appearances on other people's podcasts, exchange AMAs and X Spaces. To invite him onto your show, include the programme name, the format (recorded, live or Spaces), the proposed date and the topic. Past appearances are listed on the appearances page, grouped by host.

Press and corrections

For press questions, quotes or a correction to an episode page, email the same address and name the episode URL. Episode pages reproduce the show notes published in the podcast feed, so a correction is made at the source and the page is regenerated from it.

Listen and subscribe

The show is available on Apple Podcasts, on the @aisuede YouTube channel, and in any podcast app through the RSS feed at podcast.suedeai.ai/feed.xml.

Page last updated 2026-10-12.

## Topics

### Music IP as a real-world asset

Source: https://podcast.suedeai.ai/topics/music-ip-real-world-assets

Recordings whose show notes cover music IP as a real-world asset (RWA): putting the rights to a song on-chain so the people who made it own the asset and earn from it.

### Music royalties and the Vault

Source: https://podcast.suedeai.ai/topics/music-royalties

Recordings whose show notes cover music royalties: how on-chain settlement and payouts work, where the delay in legacy royalty payments comes from, and the Vault, which the notes describe as liquidity now for artists and royalty yield for supporters.

Source: https://podcast.suedeai.ai/topics/music-rights-registry-and-provenance

## Episodes

Newest first. Each entry gives the episode's published date, length, credit and full show notes.

### Stop Losing Rights, Own Your IP: Music RWAs, AI, x402 on Base | Jason Colapietro

- URL: https://podcast.suedeai.ai/episodes/stop-losing-rights-own-your-ip-music-rwas-ai-x402-on-base-jason-colapiet
- Episode: 33
- Published: 2026-05-15
- Length: 2:27:14
- Credit: Guest appearance, hosted by matthewjmalek.
- Topics: Music IP as a real-world asset, Music royalties and the Vault, Rights registry and provenance, Token launches and tokenomics, AI and the music industry
- Audio: https://pub-23dd340a8b2043159e3f53a4dca7b398.r2.dev/episodes/LKSMThczsrE.mp3

Jason Colapietro (founder, Suede Labs) sits down with @matthewjmalek to talk about why the music industry's IP layer is structurally broken — and how an artist-owned, on-chain stack actually pays the people doing the work.

We get into:
- Why songwriters and producers lose rights & revenue at every layer of the stack
- Music IP as a real-world asset (RWA): tokenizing rights so creators own and earn from their catalog
- Suede Labs' tooling — built so musicians keep ownership and get paid for what they make
- How x402 + the Model-Pay-Per-Call (MPP) primitive change who gets paid every time AI uses someone's work
- AI as a creator-side tool, not a replacement — agents that work for artists, not around them
- Why Base is the right home for the music stack
- The Vault: DeFi for music royalties — liquidity now, royalty yield for supporters
- Building on Arena, prediction markets, and what crypto-native distribution unlocks for independent creators

🔗 Suede Labs → https://suedeai.ai
🐦 Johnny Suede → https://x.com/johnnysuede
🎙️ Hosted by → https://x.com/matthewjmalek

Chapters:
- 0:00 Cold open — LA stories, sleep schedules
- 5:00 Crypto origin — $3k cost-basis Bitcoin, the fiancée intervention
- 15:00 Rove on Solana, $2M raise, FTX collapsing 7 days before Clerks 3
- 23:00 CZ vs Hyperliquid, Binance Labs funding DEXs
- 26:00 The Suede Labs pitch — the ownership problem (DVD vs Netflix)
- 30:00 Vatican, Vermeer & how an art-history obsession led to building Suede
- 35:00 Why blockchain belongs in music — "I mailed cassette tapes to myself"
- 36:00 AI music as the biggest shield AND biggest earning potential for artists
- 40:00 Multi-chain swap, LayerZero, 40+ chains
- 43:00 Avalanche, Build Games denial story
- 46:00 App Store war — Rove was the first blockchain app approved (+ the burn-address gaffe)
- 50:00 Live tour: Suede AI's "Create with rights" feature
- 55:00 The on-chain registry — court-enforceable proof of authorship
- 58:00 Why every celebrity-token cycle ends the same way (Iggy, Soldier Boy, Derulo)
- 59:00 The launchpad fix: tax tokens that pay artists in SOL/USDC, not their own token
- 1:02:00 Suede Social — gear forums reborn with shareable rig DNA
- 1:05:00 "Programmable artistic matter" — beyond music to all IP
- 1:08:00 Cognitive Architecture test — the founder profile (Conductor / Future Scribe / Hunter)
- 1:55:00 Suede Studio: 197 pedals, polyphonic tuner, Dr. Johnny
- 2:00:00 DSP libraries, neural amp modeler, app-store live
- 2:15:00 THE VAULT — DeFi for music royalties (the killer feature)
- 2:18:00 Wrap-up + community duck race

#MusicRWA #SuedeLabs #x402 #Base #ArtistRights #MusicIP #CreatorEconomy #OnChainMusic

### AI Will Eat Music. Here's Who Gets Paid | Jason Colapietro on Music RWAs

- URL: https://podcast.suedeai.ai/episodes/ai-will-eat-music-here-s-who-gets-paid-jason-colapietro-on-music-rwas
- Episode: 32
- Published: 2026-04-12
- Length: 20:44
- Credit: Episode by Jason Colapietro.
- Topics: Music IP as a real-world asset, AI and the music industry
- Audio: https://pub-23dd340a8b2043159e3f53a4dca7b398.r2.dev/episodes/-yeh9r_UMKc.mp3

Jason Colapietro (founder, Suede Labs) on why music IP is the next big asset class — and how an artist-owned, on-chain stack puts the people doing the work back in control.

We get into:
- Why songwriters and producers lose rights & revenue at every layer of the legacy stack
- Music IP as a real-world asset (RWA) — tokenizing rights so creators own and earn from their catalog
- How AI use of music should pay the original creator, not the platform
- Why Web3 distribution unlocks new audiences for independent artists
- Building Suede Labs on Base — the music stack for creators

🔗 Suede Labs → https://suedeai.ai
🐦 Johnny Suede → https://x.com/johnnysuede

#SuedeLabs #x402 #Base #MusicRWA #ArtistRights #MusicIP #CreatorEconomy #OnChainMusic
